canonical.tagline: The future of Electronic is here
canonical.biography_long:
Nova Artist emerged from the underground Electronic scene with a sound that defies categorization. Blending raw emotion with polished production, Nova Artist has quickly become one of the most talked-about new artists in the industry.

Raised between two cultures, Nova Artist's music reflects a complex inner world translated into sonic landscapes that resonate globally. Their debut work drew comparisons to genre legends while maintaining a freshness that is entirely their own.

Currently based in Los Angeles, Nova Artist is working on their debut album — a collection of songs that document the journey from unknown to undeniable.
canonical.biography_short: Nova Artist is an emerging Electronic artist redefining the sound of a generation.

narrative.origin_story: Nova Artist started making music in their bedroom at age 16, turning personal struggles into universal anthems.
narrative.current_chapter: Recording debut album and performing headline shows across North America.
narrative.press_narrative: The enigmatic Nova Artist is one of music's most compelling new voices.
narrative.artistic_mission: To make music that says what people feel but cannot express.
narrative.breakthrough_moment: A viral moment that turned overnight streams into a global fanbase.
